The R5 runtime keeps the largest resident layer count that fits (ten preferred, never a floor), so every resident-count-dependent figure here is reference data, not an observed or targeted placement; Main replaces or confirms it from the fresh SLOWLINK_ADMISSION_QUOTE_R5 emit.
role: INDEPENDENT PARTIAL arithmetic of the per-purpose CAPACITY census for the real MQ4 fixture on the S1 aggregate route (purpose product at tile 768, purpose primitive_selftest at tile 512, both N=10 resident, 16384-row window, 18 pages), derived from declared inputs by its own formulas and NOT read from ledger-template.json. CPU arithmetic, NOT a GPU measurement; information only, nothing here gates a hold. By design it states only the cold F16 weight shadow (the one independently known tile-census term) and the non-F16 remainder of each tile census (payload remainder plus the named allocation_backing_padding_bytes term) as a single figure; it is a deliberate subset, not a missing getter. The full per-term owner breakdown (ten tile-census terms and eight extras terms: the nine/seven payload terms plus one named allocation_backing_padding_bytes term in each) lives in ledger-template.json (the machine-read final ledger, validated by ledger_profiles.py) and in the CPU getter artifact SOURCE-CENSUS-R4.json; the harness test compares the two on the totals, the extras and the cold term. R4: every device figure is the PHYSICAL backing by the queried-granule model of the canonical arena plan (a model over the queried granule/observed capacity, NOT a per-allocation physical or recovery measurement); the model payload is recorded separately.
